name_reason: Compliant data_fd2_battle_ global. 'summon_minor_anim' = the single-sprite minor summon variant (companion to the main 12-slot anim at 0x26795); 'state5' is the dispatch state-code domain ID (the RAMP phase), not a Ghidra address residue (0x540fa shares no hex with the name); 'frame_counter' reflects the scalar counter datatype. Name accurately reflects use and type.
purpose: State-5 (RAMP phase) frame counter for the summon-spell single-sprite minor animation; runtime BSS scalar driving the ramp 1..0x2C.
logic_summary: Single accessor fd2_tick_summon_spell_minor_animation_state @ 0x275D6 (dispatch +9, last of 10). state-0 INIT seeds it to 1 (MOV byte ptr [0x540FA],1 @ 0x275F0) before any read. In state 5 it drives the ramp: blit sprite_id = counter/2 (slow 0..0x16 ramp), one-shot SFX at counter==6 and counter==0x24, then INC per tick (INC byte ptr [0x540FA] @ 0x276CC); while 0x10 < counter < 0x2C the tick returns the in-flight signal 1, otherwise 0.
element_semantics: Unsigned 8-bit ramp counter, valued 1..0x2C. Every access is byte-wide; all reads use MOVZX (zero-extend), confirming unsigned. The state-5 'counter/2' uses Watcom's signed-div-by-2 idiom (SAR/SUB/SAR) only because the MOVZX-loaded value is widened into a signed int register, but the stored value is never negative.
notes: Source comment block (anisummn.c lines 1456-1471) was already accurate and precise (state-5 ramp counter, BSS seeded to 1 in INIT, ramp 1..0x2C, frame/2 sprite id, SFX at 6/0x24, in-flight range, MOVZX unsigned) and matches the verified disassembly; kept verbatim, no Edit needed. Ghidra side: the data doc was misfiled in PRE_COMMENT with an empty PLATE_COMMENT; migrated the doc into PLATE_COMMENT (canonical field for data plates per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism) and cleared PRE_COMMENT. No logic issues found; equivalence of the ramp/SFX/in-flight logic confirmed against disassembly at 0x275D6-0x276EB.
